title: nan
authors: Lin S.; Yu F.; Zhou Z.; Li C.
key_contribution: Presents a distributed cooperative navigation method with a 9-dimensional state model and particle-based measurement noise estimation for UAV swarms in partial GNSS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
